mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.5% signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in the labor market (high UNRATE) and labor force participation (low PAYEMS growth) indicates a deteriorating economic environment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both conditions to be met.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5% and PAYEMS growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, which typically correlates with broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is above 600, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 90.0) and weak GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5%) indicates a severe economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal requires both conditions to be met.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 and GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During consumer spending recovery phases (RSAFS growth rate > 0.5%), rising consumer demand drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during consumer spending recovery (RSAFS growth rate > 0.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
